known_caveats: Historical CC0 preserved-specimen evidence supports recorded presence only. Evaluated metadata-recovery mode accepts explicitly undated historical records with one archive-audited stable identity and retained raw-row hashes. Cultivated or captive text, invalid or unresolved dates, weak identities, non-species ranks, ambiguous taxonomy, and unresolved geography are excluded. Source silence and every rejected row create no absence or non-detection assertion. The 1.2.0 reviewed taxonomy mode admits supported infraspecific concepts after individual context review and all original non-taxonomy checks.
source_warnings: NYBG physical specimens support historical recorded presence only.
The complete source archive was screened offline; only one strict retained witness per eligible county-species pair is persisted in each immutable run.
Source silence and rejected rows never support absence or non-detection.
